line.comment: * Mayhem.SelectNewLeader Gets ship with the most HULL. Does not assign a new leader.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Fix race condition where followers could follow each other.
* Serialize orphaned mercenary regrouping per sector/company.
* Normal group generation does NOT use this.
* Only orphaned followers competing to reconstruct a group do.
* Sector-local lock. Each company has its own regroup lock.
* Another regroup is already rebuilding this company's mercenaries.
* Recheck: Another follower may have already reconstructed the group.
* ===== Create group if no leaders are nearby. =====
* Preserve group state so surviving followers can reconstruct it.
